headline: VoIP-Pal Granted Leave to File Amended Antitrust Complaint in D.C. Litigation
summary: WACO, Texas, Aug. 06, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- VoIP-Pal.com Inc. (OTCID: VPLM) today announced that the United States District Court for the District of Columbia has granted the Company leave to file an amended complaint focused on its federal antitrust claims under Sections 1 and 2 of the Sherman Act against the carrier defendants AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile.
